arguments.prompt: Create ONE transparent Cartoon game sprite. Image1 is this exact original's pose/action/geometry authority. Image2 is the established adult mermaid identity and drawing style ONLY; do not copy its pose, hand gesture or profile if image1 differs. Same adult woman with very long golden blonde hair, turquoise headband, tan skin, modest green bikini top, crisp dark outlines, clean restrained cel shading. Red/white source stippling means normal tan skin, never checkered clothing. Required pose: Near-REAR view of a very low left-facing surface pose: the bowed head is at the LEFT and its face is entirely hidden behind golden hair except a tiny tan skin patch beneath the left fringe. No visible eyes or smile on the back of the head. Turquoise band runs diagonally/vertically on the back-left of the head. Long golden hair streams down and to imageRIGHT, with several tapered ends lying along the waterline. Shoulders, hands and torso submerged/hidden. Preserve source's head-high-left diagonal cascade rather than a frontal portrait. Trace each arm from shoulder through elbow to hand; hide the parts occluded by hair/body. Preserve visible waterline-only body framing: no tail, legs or extra lower body. Thin attached pale-cyan/white ripple strokes immediately beneath body/hair as original, not dark puddles or thick foam. Genuine transparent RGBA, generous clear padding around complete hair, hands and ripples. No scenery, floor, cast shadow, halo/glow, labels or props.
